lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the silver dust of ages past
Small sparks of light in shadows cast
A silent prayer carved in ancient stone
Where the sacred seeds of time were sown
[Chorus]
The stars lean down to touch the earth
In the garden where the heavens birth
A kingdom of light, a crown of gold
In the stories that the heavens told
[Verse]
The temple halls breathe deep and slow
Where rivers of starlight endlessly flow
Mountains bow low in a frozen grace
Time finds its home in this hallowed space
[Chorus]
The stars lean down to touch the earth
In the garden where the heavens birth
A kingdom of light, a crown of gold
In the stories that the heavens told
[Bridge]
The veil is thin, the spirits wake
Upon the path that the planets make
[Chorus]
The stars lean down to touch the earth
In the garden where the heavens birth
A kingdom of light, a crown of gold
In the stories that the heavens told
[Outro]
